page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a single thread per core configuration, the instance provides 128 vCPUs. The memory configuration consists of 1024.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8.0 GB per core ratio.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput data transfers. The instance does not contain any GPU hardware accelerators. The lack of local storage and GPU resources represents a tradeoff, focusing the hardware profile entirely on high-capacity memory and dedicated CPU execution.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads, reducing the need to scale horizontally across multiple smaller instances. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. This profile is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
